Synopsis:
Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel highlighted AI data center buildout as a major growth opportunity for Berkshire Hathaway Energy, underpinned by surging electricity demand. Berkshire simultaneously deepened its equity stake in Alphabet by ~$10bn, viewing it as a key AI player. Abel flagged energy supply as a structural constraint on AI expansion, positioning Berkshire's utility assets as a long-term beneficiary of data center load growth — illustrated by data centers already representing ~8% of Iowa load.

Relevance: IMPLICIT — rising electricity demand from AI data centers indirectly supports gas-fired power generation demand, but no explicit gas shortage or crisis is mentioned.
